 Rotary schedules time for drive-in dinner. 
 To help reduce traffic congestion, Bedford Rotary Club’s pork and sauerkraut dinner on Monday will begin serving at 4 p.m. this year. Again, it is a drive through event at Bedford’s American Legion. The event is sold out.
